_meta.description: Manually-curated injury status for WC26 squads. Edit as news breaks.
_meta.applied_how: Sum of `out` players' tm_value_eur_m is subtracted from the team's total squad market value before the market-value prior is applied. `doubtful` is informational only — not subtracted.
_meta.instructions: Populate `out` and `doubtful` per team. Use Transfermarkt for player values. Set tm_value_eur_m to 0 or omit if unknown — the team just won't get penalized for that specific player.
